titles.title: 2 Trees With Apricot Blossoms

description: Two bare trees with limbs that seem to fade into smoke stand on a stretch of brown earth. Hovering in the work's foreground at the bottom right corner is a cluster of pale pink flowers with bright green leaves. The flowers resemble cherry blossoms and contrast with the winter scene behind them.
title: Winter Trees with Flower
